build_coco_dataset: build a COCO detection dataset for train or val splits using the build function
create_coco_detection_dataset: create a CocoDetection dataset instance with image folder, annotation file, and transforms
convert_coco_poly_to_mask: convert COCO polygon segmentations to binary mask tensors given height and width
create_convert_coco_polys_to_mask: create a ConvertCocoPolysToMask callable to transform COCO annotations into boxes, labels, and masks
make_coco_transforms: make COCO data augmentation transforms for train or val image sets
